Overall, your research questions are well-constructed - most are clear, on-topic, and provide a solid foundation for your exposé. You’ve done an excellent job addressing the current state of research and highlighting its shortcomings, which adds depth and context to your work.

That said, the motivation section could benefit from some refinement. The purpose of this section is not only to describe the relevance of the problem but also to hook the reader and create a compelling narrative that draws them in. Currently, the transition from LLMs to holographic AI interfaces feels abrupt, and the possibilities and relevance of this emerging technology aren’t explored in enough detail. Expanding on how this technology can address specific challenges or meet needs in education would help establish its importance and captivate the reader.

Additionally, the flow of your text could be smoother. Consider reworking the structure to make your intentions clearer and ensure that each section builds logically on the previous one. Looking ahead, a more detailed exploration of how holographic AI could be implemented or its potential future applications might also help set the stage for your research, which will provide a clear roadmap for the direction of your work.
